up: Retrieve IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against the human target 'ATP-binding cassette sub-family B member 1' (ABCB1). Return one row per activity record containing: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, standard_value (IC50 in nM), assay_description, target_pref_name, and target_organism. Include only rows where canonical_smiles is not null and (pubmed_id is not null OR doi is not null). For pubmed_id_or_doi, prefer pubmed_id if available, otherwise use doi. Filter activities where standard_type is 'IC50' and standard_units is 'nM'. Ensure the target organism is 'Homo sapiens'.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.standard_value,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_pref_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'ATP-binding cassette sub-family B member 1'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)

up: Retrieve IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against the human target ABCB1. Return one row per activity record containing: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, standard_value (IC50 in nM), assay_description, target_pref_name, and target_organism. Include only rows where canonical_smiles is not null and (pubmed_id is not null OR doi is not null). For pubmed_id_or_doi, prefer pubmed_id if available, otherwise use doi. Filter activities where standard_type is 'IC50' and standard_units is 'nM'. Ensure the target organism is 'Homo sapiens'.
sql:
SELECT
   md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
   cs.canonical_smiles,
   cr.compound_key,
   COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
   a.standard_value,
   ass.description AS assay_description,
   td.pref_name AS target_pref_name,
   td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a

JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
